name: Distributed Parallel Volume Ray-Casting for Unstructured-Grid Data
definition: A distributed parallel volume ray-casting algorithm for visualizing unstructured-grid data, where both the data and rendering computation are distributed across processors. Local ray-casting is performed independently on each processor, while global image compositing is overlapped with local computation to maximize parallel efficiency.
summary: Distributed Parallel Volume Ray-Casting for Unstructured-Grid Data is a distributed rendering algorithm that maximizes parallel efficiency by overlapping local ray-casting with global compositing, avoiding dynamic load balancing.
